title: Shell Scripting (Bash)
tagline: Write real Bash scripts that automate work on Linux: safe structure, arguments, data files, error handling, testing, and complete automation projects you can reuse at work.

modules.title: Script craft
modules.summary: How professional scripts are built: structure, safe settings, arguments, exit codes, logging and a reusable template.

lessons.title: Anatomy of a real script: shebang, safe header, main and usage
Arguments done right: getopts, long options, defaults and validation
Exit codes, logging and messages to stderr
A reusable script template and ShellCheck

modules.title: Working with data
modules.summary: Reading files and input safely, parsing CSV, logs and config files, temporary files, and calling sed, awk and jq.

lessons.title: Reading files and input line by line: while read, IFS and mapfile
Parsing CSV, logs and config files in Bash
Calling sed, awk and jq from scripts

modules.title: Robust scripts
modules.summary: Scripts that fail safely: error handling, retries, locks, timeouts, testing, debugging and portability.

lessons.title: Error handling patterns: set -euo pipefail, ERR trap and retries
Locks, timeouts and running only once
Testing and debugging scripts: bash -x, PS4 and simple tests
Portability: bash vs sh, POSIX and dash

modules.title: Automation projects
modules.summary: Complete, reusable projects: backups, log monitoring, provisioning, scheduling and a deploy script, plus interview preparation.

lessons.title: Project: a backup tool with rotation
Project: a log monitor with alerts
Project: bulk user and file provisioning
Scheduling scripts: cron and systemd timers
Capstone: a deploy script and shell scripting interview questions
